julies_letter.name: Julie's Letter
julies_letter.description: Use to read. "I have drawn you a map. It was right when I drew it." A hundred-year-old envelope with this year's stamp on it.

birthday_present.name: A Small Present
birthday_present.description: Packed in the backpack with the clothes, for an aunt I have never met. I wrapped it twice, in case.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: Eat it for a quarter of your health back.

grape.name: Grape
grape.description: A tenth of your health back. They come by the bunch, and you eat the bunch.

potion_manashield.name: Small Manashield Potion
potion_manashield.description: For 20 seconds, damage is paid from mana before health. When the mana runs out, the rest is paid in full.

potion_lifesteal.name: Small Life Steal Potion
potion_lifesteal.description: For 20 seconds, 30% of the damage you deal comes back as health.

potion_critical.name: Small Critical Potion
potion_critical.description: For 20 seconds, one hit in three is critical. Julie's label says three, in her hand, underlined.

potion_stoneskin.name: Small Stone Skin Potion
potion_stoneskin.description: For 20 seconds, physical damage is halved.

potion_sparktongue.name: Small Sparktongue Potion
potion_sparktongue.description: For 30 seconds, every hit you take gives back mana.

potion_winterbite.name: Small Winterbite Potion
potion_winterbite.description: For 30 seconds, your melee chills. Hold it by the cork.

potion_stranglethorn.name: Small Stranglethorn Potion
potion_stranglethorn.description: For 30 seconds, your melee poisons. Rats will still eat meat soaked in it. So will snakes. Keep it away from your own dinner.

key_auntie_house.name: House Key
key_auntie_house.description: Opens Julie's front door. A little wet from the dog. The ring has room for two keys, and there's only this one on it.

key_generic.name: Key
key_generic.description: Opens any plain lock once, then it's the lock's. The teeth are worn almost to nothing.

key_basement.name: Auntie's Basement Key
key_basement.description: Opens both iron doors in Julie's cellar.

key_pit.name: Pit Key
key_pit.description: Opens the Company's padlocks down the mine, once each, and nothing else. GOLDSKIN is stamped on the bow.

key_mine_headmaster.name: Headmaster's Key
key_mine_headmaster.description: Opens the Headmaster's door. The tag says HM, and under it, crossed out, PAY OFFICE. It was on a dead clerk.

key_mine_vault.name: Mine Vault Key
key_mine_vault.description: Opens the vault. Heavy, off the Headmaster's own ring, and the ring is worn bright.

key_mine_boss.name: Large Mine Key
key_mine_boss.description: Opens the door everyone in the mine stopped opening. Stamped GNOX GOLDSKIN.

key_snake.name: Snake Key
key_snake.description: Fits the door with scales on it. The scales are cast into the bow, and it's cold to hold.

key_snake_boss.name: Giant Snake Key
key_snake_boss.description: Fits the giant door, and nothing else. It takes both hands to turn.

key_museum.name: Museum Key
key_museum.description: Opens the Museum's front door, across the river. Brass, tagged SCIENCE / HISTORY / ART / MAGIC. Four trades, and one tag is newer than the rest.

wood.name: Wood
wood.description: Repair eats it. Two planks mend a stair.

iron.name: Iron
iron.description: Repair eats it. Four bars mend a length of track. Rust comes off on the fingers.

rat_meat.name: Rat Meat
rat_meat.description: Not for eating. Soaked in Stranglethorn it's bait. Wrap it before it goes in the pack.

poisoned_rat_meat.name: Poisoned Rat Meat
poisoned_rat_meat.description: Throw it down in front of you. A burial snake that smells it will come, and will not leave.

gold_bar.name: Gold Bar
gold_bar.description: Grinds into four measures of dust at a bench.

gold_dust.name: Gold Dust
gold_dust.description: Manashield, Life Steal and Critical all take a measure. It gets into the seams of the pack.

coal.name: Coal
coal.description: A lump of coal. Nothing Julie wrote down asks for it. Black to the wrist after one carry.

rock.name: Rock
rock.description: Breaks down into stone at a bench.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Goes into Stone Skin. Cold, and the cold stays.

fire_stone.name: Fire Stone
fire_stone.description: Warm to hold. It will light a laid fire, and it stays warm in the pack with nothing laid to light.

deadwood.name: Deadwood
deadwood.description: Dry sticks off a stump or a pile. Two lay a fire; another keeps it going.

match.name: Match
match.description: One strike, one fire. Not in the rain. Damp ones are not worth the carrying.

light_stone.name: Light Stone
light_stone.description: Throws a circle of light with no heat in it. Nothing will grow under it.

night_view_glass.name: Night View Glass
night_view_glass.description: A lens in a brass ring, marked NIGHT. Through it the dark looks the same. I tried it twice.

small_water.name: Small Vial of Water
small_water.description: Every potion Julie wrote down starts with one.

small_empty_vial.name: Small Empty Vial
small_empty_vial.description: Dr Vane will fill it at his tap. Bring it to him in the day.

hemshade_root.name: Hemshade Root
hemshade_root.description: At the bench, with water: Firelash. It stains the fingers orange.

white_water_cap.name: White Water Cap
white_water_cap.description: At the bench, with water: Sparktongue. It squeaks against the glass.

night_lich_moss.name: Night Lich Moss
night_lich_moss.description: At the bench, with water: Winterbite. It is damp, and stays damp however long it is carried.

savage_snakeroot.name: Savage Snakeroot
savage_snakeroot.description: At the bench, with water: Stranglethorn. The undead flowers carry it. Wash after handling.

honeylace_lily.name: Honeylace Lily
honeylace_lily.description: At the bench, with gold dust and water: Critical. It smells of somebody's kitchen.

nasturtium.name: Nasturtium
nasturtium.description: At the bench, with gold dust and water: Life Steal. Peppery, if you taste it. I did.

pansy.name: Pansy
pansy.description: At the bench, with gold dust and water: Manashield. The face on it is turned away from me.

white_water_rose.name: White Water Rose
white_water_rose.description: At the bench, with stone and water: Stone Skin. Julie grew them in the cellar, and they don't wilt in a pack.
